policy: For unqualified digital character identities with multiple physical candidates, remove post-game releases, festive/companion/wrong-entity candidates, and explicit accessory-state mismatches first. Preserve multiple plausible pre-game physical variants when the profile image has not yet been visually compared.

systemic_findings: Possessive/association catalog names such as 'Pit Droid (Gasgano)' must not be treated as the named character itself.
Post-game physical releases can be excluded from source-equivalence even when their names are exact character matches.
Unqualified digital identities may still require component-level visual comparison when multiple pre-game print or headgear states exist.
